## 席位核对

- 形态:`l1-face --pr 36318` CLEAN(13 项无标记);draft、base `main`、`Fixes #36137`;13 个文件 +530 −55。门禁 check-runs @ `a383241b`:48 success · 12 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending。
- 卡关系:卡的第一条验收(设置面板的保存插进「保存到这个视图」的草稿写与发布之间,被拒、未审内容不被发布)由 `ViewConfigPanel.pinnedDraftSave-36137.test.tsx` 第一例钉住;第二条(「known edge」注释)在 `origin/main` 上 `git grep -i "known edge"` 于 content/.changeset/app-shell 零命中,属实。方向 B 本就只盖住加钉的写入方,卡文自己写明,所以 `Fixes` 成立。
- 已核属实:编辑保存的钉(`If-Match` 取载入时的版本,无草稿时用 `If-None-Match: *`)、保存回执续钉、409 打开 `DraftConflictDialog`、「继续编辑」走宿主原有的拒绝提示;`createRuntimeMetadata` 带首次写入钉;`views.mdx` 新增的一句与 diff 相符。

## 要改的两项

1. **拒收用例缺 `code` 断言。** `ViewConfigPanel.pinnedDraftSave-36137.test.tsx` 中 "is refused over a name that holds a pending draft" 只断言 `rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 409 })`。按 L1 清单(ADR-0112 信封),拒收用例要同时断言 `code` 与 `status`。改法:补上 `code: 'METADATA_CONFLICT'`(或断言 `isDraftVersionConflict(err)` 为真)。交互那几例由对话框打开来间接证明 code(`isDraftVersionConflict` 查 code),不用改。
2. **changeset 有一句没有真实调用方。** `.changeset/36137-pinned-view-draft-writes.md` 说 "A report, dashboard or page created at runtime takes the same pin.",PR 正文也说 "Same function for the runtime report / dashboard / page creates"。在本 head 上 `git grep createRuntimeMetadata` 的非测试调用只有两处,都是 `'view'`(`ObjectDataPage.tsx:506`、`objectViewViewCrud.tsx:271`)。读者会以为报表、仪表盘、页面的运行时创建也改了。改法:删掉这句,或改成只描述函数本身(「以后经同一函数创建的类型同样带钉」)并注明今天只有视图走它;正文同一句一并改。

## 范围外去向(落地前席位立卡)

- `ObjectStackAdapter.updateView` 的草稿分支(在有未发布草稿的视图上改名、置顶、设默认)仍是不加钉的「读取-合并-写回」,同样可能落进窗口里。dev 已在正文 Acceptance notes 写明只有方向 A(发布带版本前提)能关上。请席位按立卡门立一张跟进卡(方向 A,协议面,L2 归 Fable),在 ACCEPT 时把卡号写回本 PR。

修完推新 head、CI 全绿后再报一次,我在新 head 上只核 delta。

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `a383241bf79d6f05f575620d07d07a75443d33d7`
Local-runs: none

### ① Derived judgments

Inputs read: the card #36137 body and all five of its comments (triage 7065919252, claim 7073591363, dev report 7075354748, handover 7075552819, claim 7075943963; the card has no ruling comment). The PR #36318 body, its file list (13 files) and the net diff against `main` (merge base `c30ce97c`). The 60 check-runs on the head, each of which ended success or skipped: Test UI, Test Core, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint · PM dispatch-gates and the others. Code outside the diff was read to judge the diff, not reviewed.

These are the public-surface and accept-set changes the diff implies:

- `ViewConfigPanel` is a named root export of `@object-ui/app-shell` (`src/index.ts`, through `src/views/index.ts`). `ViewConfigPanelProps.onSave` changes from one parameter (`draft`) to two (`draft`, optional `saveDraft`, the panel guard's `save`). This is a widening: a host that takes one argument still type-checks and is called as before. The only host, `ObjectView`, passes the guard on. The declaration names this change correctly.
- `persistRuntimeMetadata` gains an optional fifth parameter, and it now resolves a `DraftSaveOutcome` (`saved` or `reloaded`) where it resolved nothing. `handleViewConfigSave` in `useObjectViewViewCrud` gains an optional second parameter. `createRuntimeMetadata` sends a new precondition. None of the three is exported from the package root (neither index file has an `export *`), so none is a public surface. Leaving them out of the declaration is correct.
- `createRuntimeMetadata` now sends `If-None-Match: *`, so the Console no longer writes a create over a name that holds a pending draft. The client is choosing a stricter precondition that the `/meta` door already accepts. The door's accept set does not change and the function is internal, so this is not a Clause-② narrowing. The changeset body discloses it. Correct.
- The panel's draft read changes from `metadataClient.get` with `state: 'draft'` to `metadataClient.getDraft`, which checks the drafts ledger first and then reads the envelope.
  - If the ledger lists no draft, the read resolves `null` and the save is pinned `If-None-Match: *`, the stricter of the two pins. A stale ledger can therefore only cause a refusal, never an overwrite.
  - The read and the save both name no package. The `version` the read serves and the parent the save is judged against both come from `SysMetadataRepository.headAt`'s write-address resolution. That resolution covers the draft-only binding of a view created into an app (#23657), so a view created into an app and never published saves without a false conflict. Read in `sys-metadata-repository.ts` and `protocol-lock-version-gates.ts`.
- Card acceptance line 1 is held by the new test's interleave. The settings save is refused 409 between the pinned draft write and the parked publish, and the publish carries only the Save to this view body. The dev recorded an ablation for it.
- Card acceptance line 2 is held: no tree text carries the "known edge" note. I accepted the dev's measurement, and the diff agrees with it (there is nothing to remove).

S1 (should-fix) — In `ViewConfigPanel.tsx`, `{draftConflictDialog}` is rendered only when the panel is open; the `if (!open)` early return renders a bare div.
  - How it happens: the panel can close while a save is in flight, because Discard is not disabled while `saving` and switching to another view tab (`handleViewChange`) closes it. If that save is then refused 409, the guard's `ask` waits with no dialog on screen.
  - What the user sees: no dialog and no toast (nothing throws), `saving` stays true, and the host already shows the edit as if saved (`setViewDraft` runs before the write). On `main`, the same refusal threw and the host's "Not saved" toast fired.
  - Fix: render the dialog in the closed branch as well, or above the early return, and add a test case that closes the panel before the refusal resolves.

N1 (nit) — The changeset says "A report, dashboard or page created at runtime takes the same pin", and the PR body says the same of "the runtime report / dashboard / page creates". At this head the only callers of `createRuntimeMetadata` are the two view creates (`objectViewViewCrud.tsx`, `ObjectDataPage.tsx`), so that CHANGELOG line describes a path no user can reach. Drop it, or word it as the function's rule.

N2 (nit) — The new test file's header says "every Console writer of a view draft is pinned". The draft half of `ObjectStackAdapter.updateView` is not pinned, as the PR body itself says. Say "the view settings save and the view create" instead.

N3 (nit) — When a create is refused over a pending draft, the create toasts (`formatMetadataError`, `viewSaveRefusalText`) show the door's sentence "has been modified since you loaded it". That does not tell the author that the name already holds an unpublished view. A sentence written for the create case would read better. The card does not require it.

### ② Semver level

- The changeset `.changeset/36137-pinned-view-draft-writes.md` is `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`.
  - The diff changes source in one package (`ui/packages/app-shell`); the docs page `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` publishes no package.
  - `Metadata-protocol: none` is correct: no key, value, type or default that an author writes changes, and nothing changes in `packages/spec` or the `/meta` door.
  - AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist, item 3) says a non-protocol widening ships `patch`. Correct.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` starts its line and reads the same on the PR body and the changeset body. It names the one widened root export and says nothing is removed or renamed. Nothing in the diff narrows a published accept set or a public export. The declaration is true and complete.
  - Note: `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`. It is versioned through the changeset config's `privatePackages.version` and bundled into `@object-ui/console` as a devDependency, so the widened export is not a type published to npm. Declaring it is the cautious choice, and it matches how the repo treats this prop (the objectui#11583 contract review cited in the prop's docblock). No finding.
  - `UI Published Artifacts` is skipped on the head, which fits app-shell publishing nothing of its own.

### ③ Boundary flags

- open_questions[0] asks how to route the residual window in the draft half of `ObjectStackAdapter.updateView` (options A, B, C). Answered on the merits; the choice of route is escalated.
  - Read at the head (`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`, `updateView`): it reads the draft and writes the merged body back in the same call. A pin taken from that read would carry the Save to this view draft version and pass, so option C does not close the window. Confirmed.
  - The change that leaks is the actor's own rename, pin or set-as-default. With no draft pending, that change is written straight to the published view, so the residual publishes nothing that is someone else's unreviewed draft. Ruling 7058616478 holds in substance. ADR-0037's "a draft edit stays a draft" does not hold inside that window.
  - Recommendation: B, recording the residual on #35955 or on this card. A belongs on its own protocol card, and only if the maintainer wants ADR-0037 read strictly.
  - The choice belongs to the seat or the maintainer, not to this review. `Fixes #36137` closes the card that holds the question, so the route must be recorded before the merge. Escalated to the seat, repo:objectstack#7.
- Dev deviation (1), that Clause-② was not measured on the built declarations: answered. The prop type is declared inline on `ViewConfigPanelProps`, and `ViewConfigPanel` is a named root export, so reading the source is enough; the package is not published to npm either. `Type Check UI` is green on the head.
- Dev deviations (2) and (3), the body's test count and its final-head line: answered. At review the PR body reads 6 tests and names the final head `a383241b`, patched as comment 7075980664 says.
- Dev deviation (4), commit trailers without a model name: not a contract matter. No finding.
- Dev deviation (6), the final local re-run that was not done: answered by the check-runs on the head. Test UI, Type Check UI and every other run ended success or skipped.
- out_of_scope_findings[0], the `DraftConflictDialog` module header against `readVersionToken`: confirmed.
  - `SysMetadataRepository.headAt` resolves the package-less draft write address, draft-only bindings included. The header's warning bullet, that a package-less read serves `version: null` for a package-bound draft, is therefore stale.
  - It is outside the diff, and this panel's read and save agree either way. The seat may file a docs card; this PR does not owe one.
- SQL push-down (AGENTS.md, Prime Directive 5): the diff is client-side metadata draft I/O only. It adds no record query, no id materialisation and no in-app join, so nothing could be pushed down to SQL.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `c789825862810ca5c456b9cd07a473ec3335cbca`
Local-runs: none

This is a delta review. It covers the commits from the prior head `a383241b` to this head. The prior record is comment 7076097078, and it graded S1 (should-fix) and N1 to N3 (nits). Files the delta does not touch keep the prior record's judgment.

### ① Derived judgments

Inputs read:

- Card #36137: its body and all six comments. That includes the dev report for this round, 7076624181. The card holds no ruling comment.
- PR #36318: its body, its file list, and the net diff against `main` at this head. The merge base is `c30ce97c`: 13 files, +612 −56.
- The delta from `a383241b` to `c7898258`. It is a fast-forward of three commits with no merge of `main`: `da52918b`, `55cbba6f` and `c7898258`. It touches 3 files, +101 −20: the changeset, `ViewConfigPanel.tsx` and `ViewConfigPanel.pinnedDraftSave-36137.test.tsx`. The other 10 files are byte-identical to the prior head.
- The 60 check-runs on this head: 48 success, 12 skipped, none failed or pending. They include Test UI, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build and E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Test Core, Check Changeset and Governed Surface Queue Guard. The PR is mergeable (clean).

I also read code outside the diff (`DraftConflictDialog.tsx`, the `AlertDialog` primitive, and `handleViewConfigSave`) to judge the diff. I did not review that code.

Prior findings:

- S1 (should-fix, the conflict dialog was not rendered while the panel was closed): **closed** by `c7898258`.
  - The `if (!open)` branch now renders `{draftConflictDialog}` inside the hidden container. `AlertDialogContent` portals to the document body (`AlertDialogPortal`, in `components/src/ui/alert-dialog.tsx`), so the dialog shows outside the zero-width `aria-hidden` div.
  - A save refused after the panel closed now reaches the guard's `ask`, and the dialog names the view (`conflict.name`). Each choice settles the save:
    - Keep editing throws `notSaved`, so the host's refusal toast fires.
    - Reload clears the guard's pins and bumps `authoredReads`. The panel's load effect also depends on `open`, so it reads the view again when the panel reopens.
    - Overwrite re-sends pinned to the refusal's `currentVersion`.
  - In every case `saving` returns to false.
  - The new test drives the Discard route. It parks the settings save at the door, closes the panel, then releases the 409. It asserts that the dialog opens, that the publish carries only the Save to this view body, that Keep editing reaches the host as `refused`, and that Save is live after the panel reopens.
  - The dev ablated the closed-branch line, and this case went red on the missing `draft-conflict-dialog`. The view-tab-switch route goes through the same branch, so the one test is enough.
- N1 (nit, the changeset sentence about report, dashboard and page creates): **closed** by `55cbba6f`.
  - The sentence is gone from the changeset.
  - The PR body names the measured callers. I confirmed them at this head: the two non-test callers of `createRuntimeMetadata` are `objectViewViewCrud.tsx:271` and `ObjectDataPage.tsx:506`, and both create views.
- N2 (nit, the test header said every view-draft writer is pinned): **closed** by `da52918b`.
  - The header now names the settings save and the view create.
  - It also says the draft half of `ObjectStackAdapter.updateView` is not pinned.
- N3 (nit, a refused create shows the door's "has been modified since you loaded it" sentence): **open**, and not required by the card.
  - The dev report lists it as noted but not filed. It stays a nit and does not block the merge.
- `da52918b` also adds `code: 'METADATA_CONFLICT'` beside `status: 409` in the create-refusal test. It only adds an assertion and does not change what the test exercises. Correct.

What the delta introduces:

- The delta changes no public surface and no accept set:
  - No signature, export or request precondition changes.
  - The closed branch only renders an element the open branch already rendered.
  - The `ViewConfigPanelProps.onSave` widening judged in the prior record is unchanged.
- I considered three behaviours and none is a finding:
  - **The dialog moves in the tree.** It sits in a different place in the open and closed branches, so `DraftConflictDialog` remounts when `open` flips, and its `confirming` step resets.
    - The question it is asking lives in the hook (`pending`), so the dialog stays up and nothing is sent.
    - The modal blocks the panel's own controls, so only a host-driven close could flip `open` while the dialog is up. That close would only send the author back to the first step.
  - **Overwrite after Discard.** It writes the buffer the author discarded. That happens only after the second, explicit confirmation, and on `main` a save still in flight after Discard already landed the same body.
  - **A `'reloaded'` outcome while closed.** The host returns false and shows no toast, which matches the open-panel path.
- N4 (nit, new): the PR body's Verification line says "56 check-runs, 46 success, 10 skipped". This head carries 60 check-runs (48 success, 12 skipped), as the PR comment 7076641531 says. Fix it on the next body patch if there is one. It does not block the merge.

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged from the prior record: `.changeset/36137-pinned-view-draft-writes.md` is `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`, with `Metadata-protocol: none`.
  - The delta's source change is a rendering fix inside one package. It publishes no new type or export.
  - AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist, item 3) says a non-protocol fix ships `patch`. Correct.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` still starts its line, and it reads the same on the PR body and the changeset body at this head.
  - The delta's only changeset edit drops a sentence from the description and leaves the declaration untouched.
  - The declaration is still true and complete: one widened root export, and nothing removed or renamed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The prior escalation, open_questions[0] (how to route the `updateView` residual window), is **closed**.
  - The seat filed #36350 (direction A, protocol face, `priority:p2`, `pm:blocked`, parent #36137).
  - The PR body's Acceptance notes name #36350, so the route is recorded before `Fixes #36137` closes the card.
  - This round's dev report has `open_questions: []`.
- Dev deviations this round:
  - (1) The local gate run was narrowed. Answered by the check-runs on this head, all success or skipped.
  - (2) No merge of `main`. Answered: the delta is a fast-forward, overlap-check is clean, and the PR is mergeable (clean).
  - (3) Commit trailers without a model name, and (4) the footer session URL. Neither is a contract matter. No finding.
  - (5) The first vitest attempt hit a queue timeout and was retried. Answered by the retried run and by Test UI on this head.
- out_of_scope_findings:
  - The #36350 carrier is confirmed.
  - The N3 note is handled under ① above.
  - The prior record's out-of-scope note, that the `DraftConflictDialog` module header is stale against `readVersionToken`, is unchanged. That file is outside the diff, and filing a docs card for it is still the seat's option.
- SQL push-down (AGENTS.md, Prime Directive 5): the delta is a client-side rendering fix and a test change. It adds no record query, no id materialisation and no in-app join, so nothing could be pushed down to SQL.
